Healthy Hara Bhara Kebab, packed with green veggies and paneer, but made without potato, breadcrumbs, or deep frying. It’s super easy to make, yet still gives you that delicious kebab texture and flavour we all love.
A wholesome version that’s perfect as a snack or starter, and honestly tastes just as good, if not better! Do give this one a try, the full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Cooking!
